body:
I added all the code to collect and safely connect resource changed signals because connecting signals was not thread-safe.

I see why deadlocks are possible depending on the wait change. And I understand why hacks such as the one in `_load_complete_inner()`  (`if (!import_thread)`) would be a tempation to avoid those situations.

However, now we have a thread-safe signal machinery, my assesment is that we may just simply drop all the logic and bookkeeping related to resource changed signals from the resource loader.

I don't remember if we're still maintaing a version of Godot prior to making signals thread safe. For those, patches like this one and the already existing `!import_thread` one seem to be the best option.

Given how regression prone this code is, and that the 4.7 RC 1 release is imminent, I'd encourage to go for the safest possible fix for now.

So if this approach is a workaround but a safe one, I think we should go for that, and remove the potentially unnecessary code for 4.8.
